'''2011 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 John Veasey LS Yavin 4: Massassi Headquarters''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[John Veasey]] at [[2011 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Massassi Headquarters|SE-L-yavin4massassiheadquarters.gif}}
* '''Username:''' veez
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
